scripts.build: node scripts/run-with-optional-env.mjs npm run db:generate && node scripts/run-with-optional-env.mjs npm run build --workspace @mlm/web
scripts.build:all: node scripts/run-with-optional-env.mjs npm run db:generate && node scripts/run-with-optional-env.mjs npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.db:deploy: npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run db:bootstrap
